modern_restatement_en: Write $n_k=(A_k,B_k,C_k)$ and $L_k(X)=n_k\cdot X+D_k u$ for $k=1,2,3$, with $\det N\neq0$ where $N$ has rows $n_k$. The axes are oblique with Gram matrix $G$ built from the cosines of the angles between axes. Let $P=(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)/\delta$. The parallelepiped has the planes $L_k=0$ and their parallels through $P$ as faces. Its edge vectors at $P$ are $e_k=-L_k(P)\,N^{-1}E_k$, i.e. $e_k=-L_k(P)\,(n_i\times n_j)/\det N$ with $(i,j,k)$ cyclic. The edge lengths are $\ell_k=|L_k(P)|\sqrt{(n_i\times n_j)^TG(n_i\times n_j)}/|\det N|$.
well_posed_note: The notation is odd: dividing by $u$ is equivalent to replacing $D$ by $Du$, a homogenising device, and $\delta$ is just a scaling of $P$. The parallelepiped is understood to be bounded by the given planes and their parallels through $P$. The edges also depend on the coefficients and on the axis angles, which the statement does not list.

elementary_check.plan: Use random rational planes, point and $u$, plus an oblique Gram matrix. Verify that $P+\sum e_k$ equals the intersection $Q$ of the three planes, and that each $e_k$ is parallel to the other two planes. Then compare the closed-form length with the direct length $\sqrt{e_k^TGe_k}$. PASS if all agree to 1e-9.
elementary_check.code:
import sympy as sp, random, math
random.seed(2)
R=lambda: sp.Rational(random.randint(-9,9),random.randint(1,5))
N=sp.Matrix(3,3,lambda i,j:R())
while N.det()==0: N=sp.Matrix(3,3,lambda i,j:R())
D=sp.Matrix([R() for _ in range(3)])
u=sp.Rational(7,3)
al,be,ga=R(),R(),R(); de=sp.Rational(3,2)
P=sp.Matrix([al/de,be/de,ga/de])
th=[1.1,1.3,1.4]
G=sp.Matrix([[1,math.cos(th[2]),math.cos(th[1])],[math.cos(th[2]),1,math.cos(th[0])],[math.cos(th[1]),math.cos(th[0]),1]])
L=N*P+D*u
Ninv=N.inv()
edges=[-L[k]*Ninv[:,k] for k in range(3)]
Q=-Ninv*D*u
ok1=sp.simplify(P+edges[0]+edges[1]+edges[2]-Q)==sp.zeros(3,1)
print('PASS' if ok1 else 'FAIL','P + e1+e2+e3 = intersection of the three planes')
ok2=all(sp.simplify((N[i,:]*edges[k])[0])==0 for k in range(3) for i in range(3) if i!=k)
print('PASS' if ok2 else 'FAIL','each edge parallel to the two other planes')
n=[N[i,:].T for i in range(3)]
det=N.det()
for k in range(3):
    i,j=(k+1)%3,(k+2)%3
    c=n[i].cross(n[j])
    lf=abs(float(L[k]))*math.sqrt(float((c.T*G*c)[0]))/abs(float(det))
    ld=math.sqrt(float((edges[k].T*G*edges[k])[0]))
    print('PASS' if abs(lf-ld)<1e-9 else 'FAIL','edge',k,lf,ld)
